title: test-plan template variables
description: Values for templates/test-plan.md.j2 and templates/test-plan.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from test-plan.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

baseline_rate.title: Baseline rate
baseline_rate.description: The primary metric's current value with the window it was measured over ("3.1 percent over the last 28 days"). Sample size depends on it, so a guess here quietly invalidates the whole plan.

change_description.title: Change description
change_description.description: What variant B actually does differently, concrete enough to build from. "Improved copy" is not a change; "replaces the three-step checkout with one page" is.

decision_1.title: Decision 1
decision_1.description: The decision 1 used under 'Decisions Already Made (not open for discussion)'.

expected_lift.title: Expected lift
expected_lift.description: The minimum detectable effect you are powering for, as a relative or absolute change. Ask what improvement would be too small to bother shipping, and set it just above that.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The one person who decides to stop, extend or ship this. Not the squad - a test with a committee owner runs until somebody gets bored of it.

primary_metric.title: Primary metric
primary_metric.description: The single metric that decides this. One - if you name two, you will pick whichever moved and the pre-registration was theatre.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: {}, then {} will improve by {} because. From section 'Hypothesis'.

surface.title: Surface
surface.description: The page or feature the change lives on, as users would find it. If the change touches more than one surface, you are running more than one test.

test_name.title: Test name
test_name.description: Short name for the test, naming the change and the surface - "checkout-single-page". It will be quoted in the results post six weeks from now, when nobody remembers the ticket number.
